model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата показва сравнение на дължината на отговора, дължината на разсъжденията и общата точност на моделите, обучени с различни стратегии за обучение на RL (Reinforcement Learning). Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите на моделите, а именно: SRPo, GRPO, Train/Reward, Train/Clip Upper, SRPo Clean and Baseline, SRPo Refinement, SRPo Self-Reflection, SRPo Self-Reflection SRF и SRPo Self-Reflection SRFF.  Остата е маркирана с линейна скала, започваща от 0 и достигаща до 1, като стойностите са етикетирани с интервали от 0,1.  Височината на всяка стълбица представлява стойността на съответната метрика.  Стълбиците са подредени в азбучен ред.  Стълбицата за SRPo има най-висока стойност за дължината на отговора (около 800), следвана от GRPO (около 700).  Стълбиците за Train/Reward и Train/Clip Upper имат по-ниски стойности, около 500 и 600 съответно.  Стълбиците за SRPo Clean and Baseline, SRPo Refinement, SRPo Self-Reflection, SRPo Self-Reflection SRF и SRPo Self-Reflection SRFF имат най-ниски стойности, вариращи от 0,1 до 0,2.  Всяка стълбица е визуално подчертана с различна цвят, за да се различават отделните модели.
model_annotations.Chinese: Figure 5 illustrates the training dynamics analysis of RL training samples. The figure presents a stacked bar chart comparing the number of generated samples (A) for different RL training methods: SRPo, GRPO, and a control. The horizontal axis represents the RL training methods, with SRPo, GRPO, and Control displayed as three distinct groups of bars. The vertical axis indicates the number of generated samples, ranging from 0 to 600, with a linear scale and units of samples. The scale is marked with integer values, with increments of 50, starting from 0 and ending at 600. The leftmost bar group, representing SRPo, consists of three bars, with the shortest bar having a value of approximately 115, the middle bar having a value of approximately 300, and the longest bar having a value of approximately 500. The second bar group, representing GRPO, consists of three bars, with the shortest bar having a value of approximately 80, the middle bar having a value of approximately 250, and the longest bar having a value of approximately 450. The rightmost bar group, representing the Control, consists of three bars, with the shortest bar having a value of approximately 40, the middle bar having a value of approximately 150, and the longest bar having a value of approximately 350. All bars are colored in shades of blue, with the SRPo bars being the darkest, the GRPO bars being a lighter blue, and the Control bars being the lightest. The bars are stacked on top of each other, with the bottommost bar representing the number of samples generated by the Control method, the middle bar representing the number of samples generated by the GRPO method, and the topmost bar representing the number of samples generated by the SRPo method.
model_annotations.English: Figure 5 illustrates the training dynamics analysis of RL training, comparing the performance of different RL training strategies. The horizontal axis, labeled “Training/Reward,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced approximately every 0.1 unit. The vertical axis, labeled “RL Training Dynamics Score,” shows a scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced every 0.1 unit. There are three bars representing the performance of “SRP0,” “SRP1,” and “SRP2,” each colored blue. The “SRP0” bar reaches a maximum value of approximately 0.85, the “SRP1” bar reaches a maximum value of approximately 0.75, and the “SRP2” bar reaches a maximum value of approximately 0.60.  All three bars are consistently positioned above the 0.5 mark, indicating a generally positive training dynamic score.  The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
model_annotations.German: Die Abbildung 5 zeigt eine gestapelte Balkendiagramm, das die RL-Trainingsdynamik analysiert, die von der GRPO-Strategie erzeugt wird. Die horizontale Achse stellt die verschiedenen Trainings- und Antwortlängen dar, die von 0,014 bis 0,6 in Schritten von 0,025 dargestellt werden. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Wahrscheinlichkeit dar, die von 0,0 bis 1,0 reicht, wobei die Werte in Schritten von 0,1 dargestellt werden. Der linke Teil des Diagramms stellt die Trainingswahrscheinlichkeit dar, der rechte Teil die Antwortwahrscheinlichkeit. Die Balken sind in vier Farben dargestellt: blau für „Train/Response Length“, grün für „RL Training Dynamics Analysis“, gelb für „Error and Output“ und rot für „Refinement and Correction“. Die Balke für „RL Training Dynamics Analysis“ sind in der Regel länger als die anderen Balke, wobei der längste Balken bei 0,5 liegt. Die Balke für „Error and Output“ sind in der Regel kürzer als die anderen Balke, wobei der längste Balken bei 0,25 liegt. Die Balke für „Refinement and Correction“ sind in der Regel kürzer als die anderen Balke, wobei der längste Balken bei 0,15 liegt. Die Balken sind in einer Reihenfolge angeordnet, die die Trainings- und Antwortlänge widerspiegelt.
